generator.description: Topocentric altitude and azimuth without refraction, UT1 = UTC, at 12 sites x 50 instants with the Moon above -2 degrees, plus the Sun and Sirius, Vega, Canopus, Polaris when above it; Skyfield + JPL DE440s.

frame.altitude: topocentric, from the plane normal to the ellipsoid normal, no refraction
frame.azimuth: true bearing from north through east, [0, 360)
frame.observer: skyfield.api.wgs84.latlon(lat, lon, elevation_m=height): geodetic, WGS84 ellipsoid
frame.ut1: UT1 = UTC by construction: each instant is built on load.timescale(delta_t = 32.184 + (TAI - UTC)) for its leap-second era, so Delta-T = TT - UTC and t.dut1 = 0 exactly (asserted per instant). TT, and so the positions of the bodies, are unchanged. The GHA recorded with each body comes from the same timescale and agrees with common.gha_dut1_zero_deg applied to the builtin timescale to 7.6e-06 arcsec.

generator.never_a_runtime_dependency: Generated by tools/reference/ (Python + Skyfield). CONVENTIONS section 11: never regenerate a fixture from Rust output.

timescale.delta_t_source: Skyfield's bundled skyfield/data/iers.npz, a daily Delta-T table built from the IERS finals2000A.all series at the time the Skyfield wheel was released. Outside the table Skyfield extrapolates with its long-term Delta-T model (Morrison & Stephenson / Espenak & Meeus).
timescale.dut1_definition: DUT1 = UT1 - UTC = 32.184 + Delta_AT - Delta_T, as Skyfield derives it
timescale.leap_second_table: bundled in the same iers.npz; latest offset 37 s from 2017-01-01
timescale.warning_dut1: CONVENTIONS section 6 assumes DUT1 = 0. Skyfield does not: every GHA in these fixtures uses Skyfield's UT1. The per-epoch dut1_s is recorded, and gha_deg_dut1_zero gives the same GHA recomputed with UT1 = UTC so a DUT1 = 0 implementation has a directly comparable number. 1 s of DUT1 = 15.0410686 arcsec of GHA. Beyond the Delta-T table's end the extrapolated Delta-T implies |DUT1| far above the 0.9 s that real leap seconds enforce (about -3.5 s at 2055), so gha_deg alone is not a physically meaningful prediction for far-future epochs; gha_deg_dut1_zero is.

generator.tolerance_justification: CONVENTIONS 13.7: topocentric alt_deg / az_deg (any body) worst 0.1 arcmin. Skyfield's topocentric place includes diurnal aberration (up to 0.32 arcsec) and the observer's own light-time; skyfix_ephemeris::topocentric models neither, and both are far below the tolerance.

name: moon_topocentric
notes: Each instant is chosen at random in 1990-2060 and kept only if the Moon's topocentric altitude is above -2 degrees; the Sun and the stars are listed when they are above it at the same instant.
Azimuth is ill-conditioned near the zenith: an on-sky error e appears as e / cos(alt) of azimuth. Compare azimuth scaled by cos(alt), or away from the zenith.
